scope: Canvas applicant evidence and claim status refresh on dialog close or browser return

verification.source: unchanged base implementation with the six new regression cases

new_cases: refreshes Canvas claim status after closing the dialog without issuing again
refreshes the current Canvas claim on browser focus return
refreshes the current Canvas claim on browser visibilitychange return
does not treat closing a canceled wallet claim as successful issuance
clears stale Canvas claim availability when the return status read fails
discards a late claim read after leaving the Canvas application and removes return listeners
behavior: Close invalidates the existing read-only evidence-status projection; no evidence sync job or credential offer is created.
Visible-page focus and visibility return read the server projection, with one read in progress and a coalesced follow-up if needed.
Read failure drops stale claim/evidence state and displays the existing error surface.
Unmount/application effect replacement removes return listeners and polling timers and ignores older responses.
boundaries: The ClaimCredentialDialog is mocked in these parent-component tests; its implementation has separate verification.
No Canvas provider, actual wallet, KMS signing, beta deployment, or fresh capture was exercised.
Closing or returning is not treated as proof of issuance; claimed is displayed only from a successful server status read.
D07/D08 generic recording hooks still require a real LTI Continue, approval, and wallet integration; imported attestation cases remain insufficient as current-run visible outcomes.
